notes: Iron chestplate with combat_roll:acrobat level 3 equipped in the chest slot (armor:1, head is armor:0). TRUTH: acrobat adds 0.2 + 0.2*(level-1) = 0.6 to the recharge attribute (add_multiplied_base), so the cooldown is shorter (about 80/1.6 = 50 ticks). A roll 60 ticks after the first one should succeed. Without the enchantment (same timing) it would fail. The 60-tick value is derived from the attribute math; not verified in game.
